inputs.exposure: All4 original TF2 sources already development-exposed; holdout excludes fit only, not independent final evaluation
inputs.state: Original complete conditioning/seed42 and full4 native steps, original DQ input to every step

parameters.operator: Multiply existing BF16 R256 predicted residual before its original BF16 add at the fixed two positions; no new rank/support/readout

objectives.local: Sum ideal gated local FFN SSE on identity-arm actual inputs, independent2D diagonal quadratic; original residual directions. Exact convex box solution.
objectives.flow: Full downstream flow SSE to same-state original DQ; fixed positive0.125 secant for each gain, coupled2D least-squares box solution. No parameter sweep; native candidates validate surrogate approximation.

execution_plan.two_worker_shards: shard0 input00/10, shard1 input05/15; all4 identities before6 training-only directions; all6 directions before both deterministic fits; then local/flow gains applied to all4 inputs

matched_control: Exactly same2 gain parameters, frozen main/support/bias/R256 parameters, bounds/data/current native operator; only local versus downstream objective differs. Compare both to original UB1.
substantive_change: Full transported flow target with an off-diagonal directional Gram instead of independent local FFN SSE. Gain parameterization is established and intentionally minimal, not a novelty claim.
falsifiable_prediction: Within this fixed gain family the flow-objective fit can improve actual downstream flow SSE beyond a matched local-objective fit on training and/or the fit-excluded development source. It may fail due to tiny residual directions, secant nonlinearity, quantization or source transfer.
success_rule: Report every source and exact fitted gains, native versus predicted losses, local errors and heldout flow. No post-result changes to positions/epsilon/bounds/train split. If flow fit does not beat local fit on development holdout, close this fixed gain recipe rather than increase search. Even a win is no fresh-source/video-quality acceptance.
cost: 18 full4-step native generations plus72 offline full teacher GEMMs. Candidate adds at most2 BF16 multiplications per160 FFNs; mainMAC remains50%, R256 unchanged. No inherited candidate timing acceptance. HF-derived outputs capped2GiB, reserve80GiB.
deployment_contract: Unchanged50% mainMAC, completeFFN>=1.5x including all auxiliaries, fresh pre-frozen independent sources with aesthetic/imaging/motion each<=2%drop.
forbidden: No repeated layer/rank/support/seed/bounds sweep, no official quality claim from teacher-forced videos, no automatic full candidate rollout after this diagnostic.
